premises.text: Physical-world businesses cannot execute hygienic AP steps because bills are hard and organizational functions are disconnected
premises.evidence_span: the vast majority of businesses cannot execute these fundamental steps

premises.text: Bills can be read and reconciled without manual entry via spatial mapping, deterministic language models, and one-shot learning from user actions
premises.evidence_span: We extract more than 50,000 data points from every page, the characters, and their relation to one another

premises.text: Contextualized bill data enables smart routing only to people who need to review and approve
premises.evidence_span: we can ensure the smart routing of this bill only to the people in the organization who need to review and opine on it

premises.text: Line items can be assigned to customer, job, and accounting codes with one-click suggestions
premises.evidence_span: a customer and job contextualized suggestion that, if accurate, the user can assign to every line item on the bill with a single click

premises.text: Approved bills sync into the accounting system and can be paid flexibly with captured net-term discounts
premises.evidence_span: a single click approves the bill, auto-creates the associated record in the accounting system

premises.text: A fully integrated workflow pushes contextual AP data through collaboration across the organization
premises.evidence_span: we can push this contextual data thread all the way through the process

domains.name: AP process pain for physical businesses

value.text: Data-enriched AP operations that are more effortless, efficient, and confident
value.evidence_span: prosecute their AP tasks more effortlessly and more efficiently
